_comment: The reviewed term list of the launch-onset axis (#285). `products` maps a needs.product_ref to the search terms DataLab is asked about for that product; `generic` holds category words the frequency rule in collectors/naver/launch_terms.py cannot see yet. It ships EMPTY and the axis collects nothing until a person fills it: a term is the axis, and an invented one would put a claim about a product's launch into needs.product_launch_evidence with nothing behind it. `uv run tool/derive-naver-launch-terms` proposes the candidates and prints the refusals; each kept entry has to be a term specific to that product line, because a brand plus a category word answers for the brand's whole shelf (measured 2026-09-20, round one of the #125 experiment). At most 3 terms a product (scope.json launch_onset.max_terms_per_product): the first is sent to both APIs, and all of them ride in the one search-trend keyword group. The terms are Korean data values and this file is on tool/checks/lang's allowlist for that reason (user approval 2026-09-20), beside collectors/naver/keywords.json and the anchor's two files: a translated term searches something nobody types.
